def data(name,gi,sep,exp):
    B,shape,marker=allfeats(gi,sep)
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    colcnt={j:sum(1 for i in range(h) if gi[i][j]==marker) for j in range(w)}
    rowcnt={i:sum(1 for j in range(w) if gi[i][j]==marker) for i in range(h)}
    RBh=[-1]+[i for i in range(h) if all(x==sep for x in gi[i])]+[h]
    CBw=[-1]+[j for j in range(w) if all(gi[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]+[w]
    rows=[]
    for bi in range(shape[0]):
        for bj in range(shape[1]):
            pos=B[(bi,bj)]
            cols=sorted({j for i,j in pos}); rws=sorted({i for i,j in pos})
            f={
             'out':exp[bi][bj],'n':len(pos),
             'ncols':len(cols),'nrows':len(rws),
             'mincc':min([colcnt[CBw[bj]+1+j] for j in cols],default=0),
             'maxcc':max([colcnt[CBw[bj]+1+j] for j in cols],default=0),
             'minrc':min([rowcnt[RBh[bi]+1+i] for i in rws],default=0),
             'maxrc':max([rowcnt[RBh[bi]+1+i] for i in rws],default=0),
             'samecol':int(len(cols)<len(pos)) if pos else 0,
             'samerow':int(len(rws)<len(pos)) if pos else 0,
            }
            rows.append(((bi,bj),f))
    return rows

def sfeat(name,gi,sep,exp):
    B,shape,marker=allfeats(gi,sep)
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
